concept.title: Celebrations, *on Egyptian ground.*
concept.subtitle: Three settings for an Egypt wedding or celebration produced by Sarah Haywood, with NOYA running the ground: venues, permits, stays and every guest.
concept.lead: When a client asks for Egypt, Sarah Haywood keeps the couple, the design and the production. NOYA runs the ground: venues and permits through our local partners, room blocks, guest arrivals and a guest desk for the whole stay.
concept.quote: A welcome evening facing the Pyramids, a celebration on the Nile, a weekend on the Red Sea.
